Description.DefaultText: Open the level-up screen for the current character and edit an existing build: lower skills, talents, spells and attributes, then re-spend the points. Also does a full respec. Use 'runscript respec1'. Respec mechanism credited to Peter 'weriK' Kovacs (Character Respecialization, Nexus mod 14), reused under his permission grant.
Description.en-us:
Opens the level-up screen for the current character, pre-filled with their existing build, so skills, talents, spells and attributes can be edited without rebuilding from scratch.
Open the console and type: runscript respec1 open the level-up screen, changing nothing runscript respec1 respec full respec, then reopen the level-up screen runscript respec1 <skill> [n] lower a skill by n ranks (default 1)
Requires at least one unspent skill or talent point for the screen to appear, because the game skips the level-up scenes when there is nothing to spend.
Respecialisation mechanism credited to Peter 'weriK' Kovacs ("Character Respecialization", Nexus mod 14), reused under his permission grant (modify and release improvements, with credit).
